rules.title: San Francisco Rent Board allowable annual rent increase (March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027)
rules.requirement: For rent-controlled units, the allowable annual rent increase for the period March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
rules.coverage_conditions: Units covered by the San Francisco Rent Ordinance's annual allowable increase limits; the page does not state the coverage criteria.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Coverage under the San Francisco Rent Ordinance is not described on this page

rules.citation: San Francisco Rent Ordinance (Rent Board Allowable Annual Increase, Form 571)
rules.conflict_note: Rate applies only through 2027-02-28. Prior rates: 1.4% (2025-26) and 1.7% (2024-25). The page gives no ordinance section citation or building coverage cutoff.

rules.title: San Francisco security deposit interest rate (March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027)
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay interest on security deposits at the Rent Board rate, which is 4.2% for March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.
rules.coverage_conditions: Security deposits held by San Francisco residential landlords; the page does not state the coverage details.
rules.citation: San Francisco Rent Board Security Deposit Interest Rates (Form 572)
rules.conflict_note: The page gives no ordinance section for the interest requirement. Prior rates: 5.0% (2025-26) and 5.2% (2024-25).

rules.title: Relocation payments for no-fault evictions (owner/relative move-in, demolition/removal, capital improvement, substantial rehabilitation)
rules.requirement: Tenants evicted for owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation are owed relocation payments. For notices served 3/1/26–2/28/27, the payment is $8,245 per tenant, capped at $24,733 per unit, plus $5,497 for each elderly (60+) or disabled tenant or household with minor children.
rules.key_value: $8,245/tenant; max $24,733/unit; +$5,497 per elderly/disabled tenant or household with minors (notices 3/1/26–2/28/27)
rules.coverage_conditions: Evictions based on owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation.
rules.exemptions: Relocation for temporary capital improvement evictions of less than 20 days is governed by Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9 ($446/day plus actual moving expenses for 3/1/26–2/28/27), not by Section 37.9C.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Depends on the eviction ground and the date the notice was served

rules.quoted_span: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation
rules.conflict_note: Amounts are indexed annually; these figures apply to notices served 3/1/26–2/28/27.

rules.title: Relocation payments for Ellis Act evictions
rules.requirement: Tenants evicted under the Ellis Act are owed relocation payments. For notices served 3/1/26–2/28/27, the payment is $11,110.05 per tenant, capped at $33,330.13 per unit, plus $7,443.90 for each elderly (62+) or disabled tenant.
rules.coverage_conditions: Tenants evicted under the Ellis Act (withdrawal of units from the rental market).

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only to Ellis Act evictions; amount depends on the date the notice was served

rules.quoted_span: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act
rules.conflict_note: Amounts are indexed annually; these figures apply to notices served 3/1/26–2/28/27.
